build_top_level_parser: build the top-level argparse parser with subparsers and the chat subparser for the hermes CLI
inherited_flag_register: register a CLI flag that carries over when the hermes CLI re-execs itself after session browse
oneshot_mode: run a single prompt in one-shot mode that prints only the final response to stdout for scripts
chat_subparser: build the chat subparser with query, model, provider, toolsets, and session resume arguments
resume_session: resume a previous hermes session by ID or name using the resume or continue flags
